summary: Director review. The Board holds Arthrex's claims unpatentable; the Federal Circuit holds administrative patent judges were unconstitutionally appointed and remands; the Supreme Court instead requires that the Director be able to review Board decisions. On remand the Commissioner, performing the Director's functions, denies review, and the Federal Circuit affirms. Exercises two trips through the PTAB -> CAFC link, a CAFC remand to the PTAB, Director review, and cert-denied resolving through the panel-affirmed flag.

legs.context: Arthrex owns U.S. Patent No. 9,179,907 (knotless suture anchor).

steps.event: Arthrex sues Smith & Nephew and ArthroCare in the E.D. Tex.
Smith & Nephew and ArthroCare petition for IPR2017-00275 (petition date not verified)
Preliminary response (not in the sources read; route assumed)
The Board decides institution (date not found)

legs.context: The Supreme Court holds the Director must be able to review final Board decisions and remands to the Acting Director (2021-06-21). The Board's decision stands, so the story resumes at the post-decision options, estoppel intact.

Rehearing denied (Paper 40): the Board's decision becomes the agency's final decision

gaps.event: All parties seek rehearing of the 2019 vacatur (en banc rehearing denied 2020-03-23); certiorari granted 2020-10-13; the Supreme Court vacates and remands to the Acting Director (2021-06-21)
gaps.why: Two missing pieces. (1) In the CAFC pack a vacate-and-remand goes straight to a remanded-to-* terminal: panel-to-remand sets no flag and remand-destination never reaches rehearing-window, so neither rehearing nor certiorari can follow a remand, although both routinely do. (2) No pack models Supreme Court merits review. The PTAB-side remand link (cafc-remand-to-ptab) re-enters at fwd-issued (a new FWD), not at Director review.

outcome.real: Certiorari denied, No. 22-639 (May 22, 2023); the claims stay cancelled.

deadlines.arithmetic: 37 C.F.R. § 90.3(a): 63 days. May 2 + 29 = May 31; + 30 = Jun 30 (59); + 4 = Jul 4 (63), Independence Day (a Wednesday), so it rolls to Thursday Jul 5.
deadlines.historical: Notice-of-appeal date not found; the appeal is No. 2018-2140.

deadlines.trigger_event: denial of rehearing after the second appeal (Sup. Ct. R. 13.3)
deadlines.arithmetic: Sup. Ct. R. 13.1: 90 days. Aug 11 + 20 = Aug 31; + 30 = Sep 30 (50); + 31 = Oct 31 (81); + 9 = Nov 9 (90), a Wednesday.
deadlines.historical: Petition filed 2023-01-06, about two months after the unextended date. An extension under Sup. Ct. R. 13.5 is the usual explanation, but none was found in the sources read.

quirks: The deadline check on ptab-file-noa is ambiguous about which trip it measures. The edge is walked on both appeals, and the check uses the first (from the 2018 FWD).
The PTAB pack's director-review-decision offers affirm / modify / remand; a denial of Director rehearing, which leaves the Board decision standing, is walked as 'affirmed'.
The Supreme Court's remand went to the Acting Director, a step no pack has; the second leg starts at the PTAB's post-decision options with the estoppel flag the FWD already set.
